content: entc.Extension interface: Templates() []*gen.Template, Hooks() []gen.Hook (wrap gen.Generate, run in order around core generator, mutate in-memory gen.Graph before/after codegen), Annotations() []schema.Annotation (global annotations on gen.Config visible in all templates), Options() []entc.Option (mutate gen.Config pre-generation). entc.DefaultExtension gives zero-value defaults. Multiple extensions compose via entc.Extensions(...), Hooks chains run in registration order.
